document.name: HOMIO Frontend Execution Plan
document.purpose: Define one canonical implementation plan for the HOMIO India-first, single-broker-centric real-estate consumer frontend, including complete landing-page information architecture, production modules, source files, responsive UX, REOS boundaries, brokerage conversion flow, verification and delivery order.
document.scope: This plan covers the HOMIO consumer landing page and its reusable frontend module structure. It combines the complete landing-page section model, component/file registry, UX behavior, single-broker operating model, responsive behavior, media rules, data boundaries and implementation sequence in one canonical document.
document.product_position: HOMIO uses a familiar Indian real-estate marketplace-style discovery experience, but HOMIO itself operates as a single-broker-centric consumer platform rather than a multi-broker marketplace.
document.reference_position: Established Indian property portals may be used as functional UX references for discovery patterns, search behavior and information hierarchy. HOMIO must independently author its UI, copy, components, design system, media and implementation.
document.canonical_rule: This document is the single landing-page execution plan. Do not create a second landing-page plan for the same scope.

authority.control_center: REOS Control Center remains execution and verification authority.
authority.acrl: ACRL is engineering-time continuity and repository intelligence only. It is never a frontend runtime dependency.
authority.chat: Chat is communication only and never project state.

business_model.brokerage_identity: HOMIO is the primary consumer-facing brokerage identity.
business_model.inventory_model: HOMIO-owned, HOMIO-controlled or explicitly authorized inventory may be presented.
business_model.business_rule: Marketplace-style UX does not imply marketplace business ownership.

landing_page_objective.primary_goal: Move a consumer from arrival to a useful HOMIO property-search and brokerage journey with minimum friction.
landing_page_objective.homepage_principle: The landing page is a consumer property-discovery surface, not an internal software dashboard.
landing_page_objective.primary_conversion: HOMIO enquiry or approved next action.

part_01.name: Top Header
part_01.mobile_behavior: Collapse secondary actions into a compact mobile navigation.

part_02.name: Secondary Discovery Navigation
part_02.purpose: Expose useful secondary property journeys without crowding the primary header.

part_03.name: Hero and Main Search
part_03.purpose: Make property search the dominant homepage action.
part_03.rule: The user should understand the primary property-search task immediately after entering HOMIO.

part_04.name: Quick Property Discovery
part_04.purpose: Provide fast shortcuts for common consumer searches.
part_04.behavior: Each shortcut opens an approved search context rather than creating independent frontend search logic.

part_05.name: Popular Cities
part_05.purpose: Provide direct entry into major property markets.

part_06.name: Popular Localities
part_06.purpose: Move users from city-level discovery to locality-level search.
part_06.rule: Market facts must come from approved authoritative capabilities.

part_07.name: Featured Projects
part_07.purpose: Promote approved project inventory and project discovery.
part_07.inventory_rule: Projects must be HOMIO-owned, HOMIO-controlled, authorized, or supplied by a verified REOS capability.

part_08.name: New Project Collections
part_08.purpose: Organize approved projects into understandable discovery categories.

part_09.name: Fresh HOMIO Properties
part_09.purpose: Present recent or fresh approved inventory.
part_09.rule: Freshness must come from authoritative data or approved content configuration.

part_10.name: Owner or Direct Properties
part_10.brokerage_rule: Owner-origin inventory still enters the approved HOMIO brokerage and lead workflow.

part_11.name: Verified Properties
part_11.rule: Frontend must never manufacture verification status.

part_12.name: Property Collections
part_12.purpose: Help consumers discover properties by useful lifestyle or decision categories.
part_12.rule: Collections must be backed by approved REOS capability or approved editorial configuration and must not become an unverified ranking engine.

part_13.name: Commercial Real Estate
part_13.purpose: Expose commercial property discovery as a first-class HOMIO journey.

part_16.name: Plot and Land
part_16.purpose: Provide specialized plot and land discovery.

part_17.name: Property Tools
part_17.purpose: Support property decisions without overpowering the discovery experience.
part_17.rule: Tools are supporting experiences, not the homepage's primary business journey.

part_18.name: Market and Locality Intelligence
part_18.purpose: Help consumers understand markets and localities.
part_18.rule: Authoritative numbers and factual claims must come from approved capabilities.

part_19.name: HOMIO Advice
part_19.purpose: Provide educational content that helps property decisions.

part_21.name: Builder and Project Discovery
part_21.rule: Builders are inventory or project stakeholders, not competing consumer brokers on the HOMIO surface.

part_22.name: Save and Compare Promotion
part_22.purpose: Encourage users to organize property decisions.

part_23.name: HOMIO AI
part_23.purpose: Add contextual AI assistance around search, property and decision workflows.

part_24.name: HOMIO Brokerage CTA
part_24.purpose: Differentiate HOMIO from multi-broker marketplaces by converting discovery into the HOMIO brokerage journey.
part_24.message_model: Found a property you like? Connect with HOMIO.

part_25.name: Post Property
part_25.purpose: Allow authorized owners and professionals to submit property inventory into HOMIO.
part_25.rule: Frontend provides submission UI only; validation and inventory authority remain outside the frontend.

part_26.name: Why HOMIO
part_26.purpose: Communicate the consumer value of HOMIO simply.
part_26.copy_rule: Use consumer language only; do not expose backend architecture on consumer pages.

part_27.name: Trust and Transparency
part_27.purpose: Increase user confidence without overstating certainty.

part_28.name: My HOMIO
part_28.purpose: Bring the user back to their ongoing journey.
part_28.rule: My HOMIO aggregates canonical references and does not become a second business database.

part_29.name: Help and Support
part_29.purpose: Provide safe recovery and support paths.

part_30.name: Footer
part_30.purpose: Provide broad navigation and legal information.

production_module_registry.rule: One named production module maps to one primary source file unless a framework, configuration, test or generated-file exception explicitly applies.

page_composition.rule: page.tsx is a composition layer and must not become a monolithic homepage implementation.

rules: Do not simply shrink desktop layout.
Keep price, type, location and main action immediately visible.
Move secondary information behind sheets or progressive disclosure.

search.frontend_role: Present search capability and preserve search context.

lead.frontend_role: Initiate approved enquiry and show authoritative results.

media_governance.fallback: Use a HOMIO-controlled media placeholder if approved media is unavailable.

competitor_reference_rules.purpose: Learn familiar property-search user flows without reproducing proprietary implementation.
competitor_reference_rules.homio_requirement: HOMIO must independently author its brand, copy, UI components, spacing system, typography, colors, icon usage, media and code.

consumer_does_not_see_as_primary_model: multiple unrelated brokers competing for the same lead
single_broker_experience_rules.rule: Partners may provide or manage authorized inventory, but consumer-facing brokerage identity remains HOMIO.

structure: Every landing-page part maps to a named module.
Every named module maps to one primary source file.
No duplicate module performs the same homepage responsibility.
ux: Primary consumer journeys are one clear action away.
HOMIO brokerage action is visible without becoming aggressive.
Secondary tools do not overpower discovery.
business_boundary: No multi-broker marketplace behavior is introduced.
HOMIO remains the primary consumer brokerage identity.
Lead ownership remains authoritative outside the frontend.
Inventory ownership remains authoritative outside the frontend.
Deal and commission logic remain authoritative outside the frontend.
media: No prohibited competitor media is used.
No unlicensed production images are used.

coding_rules.rule_01: Create the reusable shared module before duplicating UI logic.
coding_rules.rule_02: One named landing-page module equals one primary source file.
coding_rules.rule_04: Feature modules do not own canonical business logic.
coding_rules.rule_05: Do not create a frontend search engine.
coding_rules.rule_06: Do not create a frontend inventory authority.
coding_rules.rule_07: Do not create a frontend lead engine.
coding_rules.rule_08: Do not create a frontend deal engine.
coding_rules.rule_09: Do not create a frontend commission engine.
coding_rules.rule_10: Do not import ACRL into runtime frontend code.
coding_rules.rule_11: Do not read state.json in the browser.
coding_rules.rule_12: Do not read architecture JSON files in the browser.
coding_rules.rule_13: Do not invent unverified API contracts.
coding_rules.rule_14: Unavailable capabilities become safe unavailable states.
coding_rules.rule_15: Use owned or properly licensed production media.
coding_rules.rule_16: Do not copy competitor proprietary assets.
coding_rules.rule_17: Marketplace familiarity must not become visual cloning.
coding_rules.rule_19: Keep primary search stronger than secondary services.
coding_rules.rule_20: Preserve user context when navigating to property/project details.
coding_rules.rule_21: Every important action requires appropriate pending, success, error and unauthorized states.
coding_rules.rule_22: HOMIO remains a single-broker-centric consumer experience.

architecture: This document is the single landing-page execution plan.
Frontend remains subordinate to the Master Architecture.
landing_page: LP01-LP30 are implemented according to the registry.
All required property discovery categories are represented.
Projects, properties, localities and markets have clear entry points.
Tools and advice exist without overpowering discovery.
My HOMIO and Help are accessible.
business: No competing multi-broker marketplace layer is introduced.
Transaction and commission authority remain outside the frontend.
media: HOMIO-owned or properly licensed production media only.

then_check: latest verified REOS capability required by the active module
new_chat_bootstrap.continuation_rule: Resume from the first incomplete landing-page part or dependent shared module. Do not restart completed modules without evidence of regression.
